ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) focal points comprising approximately 5-7% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation field across the entire ventral surface; high-contrast white clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; sparse, high-intensity linear and circular pixel clusters scattered primarily on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 75 degrees; deep indentation relative to the total fluke chord depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate serration frequency along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits irregular micro-peaks caused by external colonization; left lobe distal edge shows a significant flat, truncated segment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes; isolated white circular pixels visible on the mid-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of fine, white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally on the upper half of the left lobe; distinct diagonal white streak near the lower peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical truncation/amputation of the distal tip of the left lobe, resulting in a squared-off pixel boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme contrast between the rounded, barnacle-encrusted right tip and the flat-edged, truncated left tip.
